title: Chapter 1 targeted annotation audit
scope: All 30 old scan-decision annotation/layer records at units <=2635 except U00542 lexical correction; U01811-01812 is a joint record. Includes follow-up verification of U01067, U01090, U01811-01812. Plus eleven additional flat-transcript or structural candidates U00187, U00192, U00272, U00317, U00318, U00328, U00534, U00626, U00710, U00800, U01144. This is targeted annotation verification, not complete main-text proofreading or full multi-witness collation.
method: Inspected native embedded facsimile images with full-page, overlapping half-page, and focused crops. No OCR or generative image editing. Single-shad Wylie proposals express reviewed lexical main readings; electronic whitespace and physical lineation are not equated. Local non-observation never establishes absence from the entire witness.
